name: Athena Home Loans

assessmentBufferPct.note: Not published. Checked athena.com.au TMD set (Straight Up/Power Up/Fixed, Tailored, Tailored Plus), /eligibility, /tailored and the borrowing-power calculator page — Athena publishes no assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap or rent shading.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Tailored), effective 17 November 2025
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Tailored product: "Loan to value ratio (LVR) Up to 85% LVR". The core Straight Up / Power Up / Fixed products cap at 80% LVR (separate TMD, same effective date).

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Tailored), effective 17 November 2025
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: The TMD attribute table states 85% LVR across a single Owner Occupier / Investor row; it does not break the cap out by purpose, so the investment figure is read from the same row.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Athena — Tailored lending options ("Lower deposit solution: 80-85% No LMI")
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: "We're one of the few lenders that offers 15% deposit home loans, meaning you can borrow up to 85% of your property's value, without LMI." Page carries no publication date; asAt is the date the page was read.

notes.value: Core products (Straight Up, Power Up, Fixed) are capped at 80% LVR per the current TMD effective 17 November 2025; the Tailored product extends to 85% LVR with no LMI.
notes.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed)

altDocAvailable.note: Tailored is designed for customers who "borrow funds by providing alternative proof of their self-employed income (i.e Alt Doc lending)".

altDocEvidence.value: Lite Doc: flexible income verification options such as a letter from the applicant's accountant, where full/up-to-date financials are not available.
altDocEvidence.note: Undated page; asAt is the date read.

selfEmployedMinYears.sourceTitle: Athena — Tailored lending options, FAQ "I'm self-employed. Which loan options do I have?"
selfEmployedMinYears.note: "For our Tailored Lite Doc loan you need to have been in business for at least two years." Full-doc self-employed applicants may use Straight Up / Power Up with full financials. Undated page; asAt is the date read.

notes.value: Security must meet Athena credit policy: located within an acceptable postcode, an acceptable building type, not primarily used to operate a business, well maintained and in good condition, not requiring nor under construction, and within Athena's land size restrictions.
notes.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1
notes.note: The acceptable-postcode list and land-size limits themselves are not published.

postcodeRestrictionsPublished.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1
postcodeRestrictionsPublished.note: The TMD refers to "an acceptable postcode" but no postcode list is published on the public site.

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1
minLoanAmount.note: Same minimum stated in the Tailored and Tailored Plus TMDs.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1
maxLoanAmount.note: Same maximum stated in the Tailored and Tailored Plus TMDs.

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.0
offsetAvailable.note: Offset sub-accounts are a Power Up feature; Straight Up has no offset.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.0
redrawAvailable.note: Unlimited additional repayments and redraw at any time on the variable options.

value.conditions: Must be living in Australia. TMD residency attribute: "Australian/NZ permanent residents living in Australia".
TMD requires the applicant to be living in Australia.

rules.sourceTitle: Athena Target Market Determination (Straight Up, Power Up & Fixed), s2.1 Residency
rules.note: The TMD wording "Australian/NZ permanent residents living in Australia" is ambiguous as to NZ citizens on subclass 444; that case has been left out rather than guessed. The expat exclusion is read from the "living in Australia" requirement, not from an explicit exclusion.

gaps: No servicing parameters published at all — no assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, credit-card assessment rate or HEM treatment appears anywhere on the public site.

No public broker credit policy guide. Athena's TMDs name accredited brokers and referrer networks as a distribution channel, but there is no public broker portal or policy document; accreditation appears to be by arrangement.
Employment tenure minimums (PAYG probation, casual, contract) are not published.
Credit-history knock-outs (defaults, bankruptcy, arrears, enquiries) are not published.
Acceptable-postcode list, land-size restrictions, minimum unit size and high-density policy are referred to in the TMD but not published.
Genuine savings, gifted deposit and guarantor policy are not published.
Interest-only maximum terms are not published (the TMD confirms IO is available but not for how long).
